categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Jinji Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: dye manufacturing and computing power services. The dye segment focuses on the research, production, and sales of reactive and disperse dyes, with a comprehensive product portfolio. The computing power segment, operated through its subsidiary Yingzhi Innovation, provides AI computing power rental and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs mature production technologies for reactive and disperse dyes, including continuous chemical processes such as sulfonation, nitration, acylation, extraction, and hydrogenation. It holds 22 invention patents related to reactive dyes and continuously improves product quality and production processes. The computing power business leverages advanced AI algorithms (DeepSeek) and high-performance computing clusters to provide AI model deployment and management services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are downstream industries including textile printing and dyeing, textile manufacturing, and apparel sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales in Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shandong, Jiangsu, Shanghai, and overseas. The computing power services target enterprises requiring AI model training and deployment, mainly in internet, finance, manufacturing, and government sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with key production facilities in Jiangsu Province's Taixing Economic Development Zone and Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Sales are concentrated in major Chinese provinces such as Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shandong, Jiangsu, Shanghai, and Fujian, with about 10% of revenue from overseas markets. The computing power business is based in Shenzhen.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jinji Industrial operates primarily in the midstream and upstream segments of the dye industry, producing dyes and dye intermediates such as H acid and para-ester. It also extends upstream by manufacturing dye intermediates internally to reduce external dependency. The computing power business operates downstream by providing AI computing resources and services to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on technological innovation and new product development to enhance dye product performance, including high fixation rate, color fastness, uniform dyeing, and environmental friendliness. It aims to build a well-known reactive dye brand and expand market share. In computing power, it plans to complete a 2,000P AI computing power project and gradually build a 10,000P intelligent computing network, integrating AI technology with industry applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of dyes and dye intermediates, accounting for over 97% of total revenue. The computing power segment generates revenue through service contracts for AI computing power rental and model deployment, recognized over the service period. The company also earns income from government subsidies and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jinji Industrial is one of the leading domestic producers of reactive dyes in China, with a comprehensive product range and strong market position in the reactive dye segment. It competes with other large-scale dye manufacturers in China and benefits from industry consolidation trends. In the AI computing power sector, its subsidiary Yingzhi Innovation holds a leading position in Shenzhen with advanced infrastructure and service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.009 billion, a 6.45% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 5.65 million, a 64.34% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 2.6 billion, growing 7.05% from the previous year. The dye business remains the main revenue contributor, while the computing power segment is in early growth stages. The company faces profitability pressure due to increased depreciation and financing costs from new projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jinji Industrial emphasizes its broad and diverse dye product portfolio, combining scale production with customized solutions to meet varied customer needs. Its products have multiple international environmental and safety certifications (e.g., BLUESIGN, ECO-Passport, GOTS, OEKO-TEX), enabling access to global green textile markets. The company integrates R&D with production and sales, ensuring rapid innovation and quality improvements. Its computing power services offer high-performance AI infrastructure with one-stop model deployment and operation, supporting clients' efficient AI application.
